title: High-Volume Multi-Buyer
scenario: Find 'customer_id' who bought more than 3 distinct products. Return 'customer_id' and 'distinct_count'.
hint: Group by customer_id and use HAVING on distinct count.
correctQuery: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT product_key) AS distinct_count FROM customer GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT product_key) > 3;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE customer (customer_id INT, product_key INT); INSERT INTO customer VALUES (1, 1), (1, 2), (1, 3), (1, 4);
